_doc: Layer A lexicon (Amendment 3 to OSF TDW6C, section 4.1). Matching: lower-cased page text, words hyphenated across line breaks joined, white space collapsed; each pattern is a Python regular expression wrapped in \b...\b, case-insensitive. Fixed before execution; any later addition is reported separately.

families.name: Temporal and out-of-sample evaluation
families.relevant_if: a model is evaluated on observations not used to fit it; record whether those observations belong to a period after the fitting period (time-blocked test)

families.name: Fouling and equipment degradation
families.relevant_if: fouling, deposits or equipment degradation is named as a cause of change in the energy relation, of model error or of a model limitation

families.name: Catalyst activity and run length
families.relevant_if: catalyst activity, deactivation, regeneration or run length is named as a cause of change in the energy relation, of model error or of a model limitation

families.name: Code and data availability
families.relevant_if: code or data used for the model is stated to be available (repository, supplementary files, on request)

families.name: Feed and product characteristics
families.relevant_if: feed or product characteristics (quality, composition, grade, slate, mix) are used or discussed as an explanatory or normalising variable

families.name: Re-estimation and updating
families.relevant_if: a rule or practice for re-estimating or updating the model or baseline is stated

families.name: Validity domain
families.relevant_if: a domain of validity for using the model is stated (operating range, envelope, bounds of applicability)
